Use ULONG_PTR for GetQueuedCompletionStatus output. The key is not consumed by TcpClient and registrations still use zero; bytesTransferred remains a DWORD-width count. This is the separate client-side IOCP site exposed by the fresh x64 build.

Native v120 actual sharedNetwork project rebuilds pass Debug/Release on Win32/x64 with the matching client edit. A real Windows posted-completion probe retains a high-bit x64 key and surrounding guards in all four configurations. This does not exercise a full TcpClient connection or a server build; server Windows source mirrors the same one-line correction.

Compile the actual Sock, TcpClient and TcpServer translation units using the checkout project inputs. Check both UDP header copies in both include orders, raw UDP and IOCP behavior, and independently reverted completion-key declarations against the real SDK.

Require every matrix outcome, preserve source/header identities and raw logs, and propagate failures. Document the explicit imemmove prerequisite and separate compile/API evidence from production network runtime behavior.
